themes.name: Agentic AI for Development
themes.description: Articles discussing AI agents used for coding, development workflows, testing, and infrastructure management, including their capabilities, limitations, and security implications.

themes.name: AI Coding Assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that assist developers in writing, auditing, and debugging code, including their effectiveness and potential vulnerabilities.

themes.name: AI Customer Insights
themes.description: Covers AI platforms and tools specifically designed to gather and analyze customer data for better engagement and understanding.

themes.name: AI for Product Research
themes.description: Articles that explore how AI is being applied to the processes of product research and development, including supply chain automation.

themes.name: Synthetic Users
themes.description: Discussions around the use of AI-generated users or data for testing and research, particularly in contexts where real-time data is restricted.

themes.name: AI Research Platforms
themes.description: Articles detailing AI tools and platforms used for various research purposes, including image analysis and general research operations.

themes.name: AI Workforce Impact
themes.description: Examines the influence of AI on job roles, skills required, and employment models within the tech industry, particularly in AI engineering.

themes.name: AI for Design & Research
themes.description: Covers AI applications that directly assist in the design process or enhance traditional UX research methodologies.

themes.name: AI Chatbot Research
themes.description: Focuses on research and user feedback regarding the capabilities and limitations of AI chatbots.

themes.name: AI Summarization
themes.description: Articles related to AI tools that condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries for insights.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
